responsibility: Implements token metadata helpers for the Rust lexer/parser boundary. This file maps `TokenId` enum values to human-readable descriptions and symbolic names using the token x-macro list, converts `PrimitiveCoreType` hints to textual spellings, and provides `Token` accessors such as `get_type_hint_str` and the checked `get_str` path that emits diagnostics when code requests string payloads from tokens that do not carry one.
same_name_distinction: Provides the out-of-line helper implementations for the token model declared in `rust-token.h`, notably enum-to-string/description mappings and checked accessors like `Token::get_str`/`get_type_hint_str`, whereas the header defines the token kinds, type-hint enum, and `Token` data structure/factory API itself.
